dedupe_keys.name: replication package structural resilience and geopolitical disruption risk in turkiye s submarine cable systems

description: Huseyin Saltan publishes a reproducible assessment of five submarine communication cable systems connected to Türkiye: SeaMeWe-5, MedNautilus, KAFOS, Turcyos-1 and Turcyos-2. The September 2026 ZIP package contains an R/RStudio workflow, selected inputs, documentation and derived results under CC BY 4.0. It constructs connectivity networks, simulates single, double, regional and landing-point disruptions, and combines structural criticality with conflict exposure using UCDP and GDELT. Fifty-four alternative specifications test sensitivity. These materials support replication and adaptation of cable-resilience simulations. The resulting index compares consequences and exposure; it does not estimate sabotage probability. Reconstructed geodesic routes are approximate, and engineering alignments and predictive validity remain unknown. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this application. Input files, manuscript and analysis code were not downloaded or executed.
